invariant: DescriptionDiagramFactory command regexes are compiled through Pattern2.compileInternal with CASE_INSENSITIVE. Every spelling of a CommandCreateElementFull.ALL_TYPES keyword therefore both selects the same DESCRIPTION factory and is consumed by the same element command. CommandCreateElementFull also treats its `as` token case-insensitively. The selector and selected parser form one contract: a line credited as component evidence must materialize the same Entity under uppercase, lowercase, or mixed-case command and AS spellings. Case changes affect neither identifier spelling nor label text, package ownership, constructor order, layout dimensions, nor SVG geometry.
causal_divergence: Rust has a shared detect_uml_subtype selector in front of separate deployment and component-backed DESCRIPTION parsers. Commit 40394d67 repaired the selector boundary: it case-folds the leading semantic token, so the prior uppercase DATABASE, mixed-case NoDe, and mixed-case FrAmE examples now reach the intended product path. The independent follow-up disproved completion one layer later. parse_component's container_keyword is case-insensitive and identifies a mixed-case `CoMpOnEnT` line as the canonical `component` keyword, but leaf components are intentionally delegated to RE_COMP. RE_COMP is anchored to lowercase `component` and lowercase `as`, so it consumes neither `CoMpOnEnT "Telemetry" As Alias` nor `COMPONENT Api`. The parser returns a valid but empty ComponentDiagram and renders the empty DESCRIPTION canvas. The existing dispatch unit test asserted only Diagram::Component and therefore missed loss of the declaration. This is a selector/consumer contract violation in the component leaf command, not a score-weight, renderer, storage-container, or artifact-container problem.
planned_change: Make only RE_COMP's semantic command token and AS token ASCII-case-insensitive, mirroring Pattern2.compileInternal, while leaving captured labels and identifiers verbatim. Strengthen the parser test to assert the selected ComponentDiagram contains the expected component identity and display label for mixed-case quoted-AS and uppercase bare forms. Rerun all six prior accepted inputs and the two fresh mechanism-specific failures. Treat the four storage/artifact container failures in the follow-up as adjacent symbol-model residue under separate causal accounts; do not fold their geometry into this command-case change. Do not change subtype scores, layout constants, symbol renderers, comparator behavior, or output strings after rendering.
